methodology: Bounded first-pass review following open PR #265 and main snapshot; compare the Moses/magicians sequence with Exodus 7:10–13 (English version at Bible.com, ESV; Hebrew and Greek critical editions NOT collated). records.topic: Officials advise postponing Moses and Aaron
records.notes: Qur'an reports advice to delay both brothers and gather specialists; Exodus instead reports Pharaoh summoning magicians and their later reactions.
records.pending_question: Verify Arabic pronoun referents and Hebrew sequence; no exact postponement instruction established.

records.topic: Summon skilled magicians from the cities
records.notes: Both narratives involve Egyptian practitioners of magic; Exodus has Pharaoh summon magicians, but not an explicit nationwide city-by-city recruitment.
records.pending_question: Check Hebrew and Greek Exodus and any securely pre-Islamic retellings; no city-specific equivalence.

records.topic: Magicians approach Pharaoh requesting a reward
records.notes: The magicians appear in Exodus but a negotiated reward before the contest is not present in this passage.
records.pending_question: Look for an independently dated earlier narrative of payment; do not infer from shared character roles.

records.notes: Exodus does not report Pharaoh promising the magicians courtly proximity or payment.
records.pending_question: Check earlier Jewish, Syriac and Christian witnesses before declaring absence across traditions.

records.topic: Magicians offer Moses the choice of who casts first
records.notes: Exodus describes Aaron casting his staff before the magicians cast theirs, but does not narrate a negotiated order or choice offered to Moses.
records.pending_question: Compare sequence and actor roles in MT and LXX; consider this a contrast rather than exact speech parallel.
